summary: Native session discovery bounds process queries and transcript reads, joins running OMP sessions through open transcript files and full native IDs rather than resume arguments, and resolves saved-session show requests through a background history index.

rules.detail: No permission changes; import remains a takeover operation, not attach.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol changes. OMP processes without unambiguous open-transcript evidence remain unresolved. Exact saved lookup rejects duplicate full IDs.

downtime.detail: No service interruption beyond normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Cold history indexing and unavailable OS evidence return bounded discovery errors.
